capabilities: Add a reset button below every checklist
Insert custom-labeled reset code blocks under checklists
Reset all checkboxes in the active note via command
extras: The README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff and that installation from the community browser is only available once published.
motivation: The README frames the pain as no need to recreate the list every day, implying the author built it to reuse recurring checklists.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to uncheck a completed checklist in bulk, so recurring daily or weekly lists must be recreated or manually cleared.
summary: Checklist resetter that adds buttons and commands to uncheck completed items, so recurring lists can be reused without recreating them.
